title: Wedge multiplication before passing to a quotient
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $A,B$ sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, $f:A\to B$ any morphism, and $r,s,t\in\mathbb N$ with $t=r+s$. Using exterior sheaves [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], there exists $\psi:(\bigwedge^r A)\otimes(\bigwedge^s B)\to\bigwedge^t B$ such that for every open $U$, $a\in A(U)^r$ and $c\in B(U)^s$, $\psi_U((\bigwedge_i a_i)\otimes(\bigwedge_j c_j))=\bigwedge(f_U(a_1),\ldots,f_U(a_r),c_1,\ldots,c_s)$. Neither exactness nor local freeness is assumed.

source.place: Proof of (*), determinant paragraph: exterior-power universal properties and independence of quotient lifts

proof.text: Use multiplication in the exterior algebra to construct a bilinear map from degree r and degree s to degree r+s. Since the degree-n exterior power is the nth power of the range of the degree-one inclusion, pow_add and Submodule.mul_mem_mul show that products lie in degree r+s. Compose in the first factor with exteriorPower.map induced by f and in the output with the target sheafification unit. ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_mul_ιMulti and exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti give precisely the concatenated pure-wedge formula.

Verify restriction compatibility on two pure wedges, using the defining restriction formula of exteriorSheafRestriction_existsUnique, naturality of f, and naturality of the target sheafification unit. Fin.addCases verifies the two blocks of the concatenated tuple. Apply Submodule.span_induction first to the second exterior factor and then to the first, using exteriorPower.ιMulti_span. Additivity and semilinearity of all restriction maps extend compatibility to arbitrary sections of both exterior presheaves.

The identity ring morphism is locally injective and locally surjective. Apply existsUnique_bilinear_sheafification_extension to the natural bilinear family into the target exterior sheaf, obtaining a natural bilinear family on the two exterior sheaves with its unit equation. Apply tensor_bilinear_universal to obtain the desired tensor-sheaf morphism. Compose its pure-tensor formula, the bilinear extension unit equation, and the sectionwise wedge formula. Substitute t=r+s at the beginning, so Fin.cast ht becomes the identity. No exactness, local freeness, or rank bound is used, and the construction includes empty blocks.

proof_origin.note: The sectionwise bilinear map is explicit exterior-algebra multiplication. The descent and tensor universal properties use the already-proved generic library declarations; no change to the determinant argument or unit route.

lean.statement:
theorem exteriorSheaf_wedgeMap_exists {X : Scheme.{v}} {A B : X.Modules}
    (f : A ⟶ B) (r s t : ℕ) (ht : t = r + s) :
    ∃ ψ : exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf B s ⟶ exteriorSheaf B t,
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r → A.val.obj (op U))
        (c : Fin s → B.val.obj (op U)),
        ψ.val.app (op U)
          (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection A r U a) (exteriorSheafSection B s U c)) =
          exteriorSheafSection B t U
            (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast ht i))
